post.summary: Import any supported document, detecting its format
post.description: Send the document itself as the body (JSON, YAML, XML or GraphQL SDL). Detected: OpenAPI 3, WireMock mappings, MockServer expectations, Postman collections, HAR, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, SoapUI projects and Microcks APIExamples. A format without a converter in this build answers 415. Options go into the query string.

post.summary: Generate stubs from a GraphQL schema (SDL)
post.description: One stub per Query and Mutation field, matching requests whose root field is that field and answering `{"data": {<field>: <example>}}`. Examples from a Microcks APIExamples document become higher-priority stubs matching the request variables.

post.summary: Generate stubs from a HAR 1.2 capture
post.description: Each distinct request (method, path, query, body) becomes a stub replaying the first recorded response. Failed entries are skipped; sensitive headers, query parameters and body fields never reach the stubs.

400.description: Not a HAR document, invalid filters or tag

post.summary: Apply a Microcks APIExamples or APIMetadata document to an imported service
post.description: The service is found by `metadata.name` and `metadata.version`. APIExamples add example stubs (tag `<service tag>:examples`, replaced on re-import). APIMetadata adds labels and per-operation delay and dispatcher overrides; for OpenAPI services the stubs are regenerated with the overrides, which are kept across re-imports.

example.document:
apiVersion: mocks.microcks.io/v1alpha1
kind: APIMetadata
metadata:
  name: API Pastry - 2.0
  version: 2.0.0
  labels: {team: pastry}
operations:
  'GET /pastry/{name}':
    delay: 100

post.summary: Convert MockServer expectations into stubs
post.description: Accepts one expectation, an array of expectations, or `{"expectations": ..., "tag": ..., "replace": ..., "dryRun": ...}`. Query parameters override the wrapper fields. Velocity and JavaScript templates and class callbacks are never executed: such expectations are skipped with a warning.

post.summary: Generate stubs from a Postman collection
post.description: Every saved example response becomes a stub: method, path (`:id` and unresolved `{{var}}` segments become path parameters), enabled query parameters and, when a request has several examples, its raw body. `{{var}}` is resolved from collection and folder variables; folders become tags. Requests without saved examples are skipped with a warning. Response bodies are not templated.

400.description: Not a Postman v2 collection, invalid tag or invalid stub

post.summary: Generate stubs from a SoapUI project (Microcks' SOAP format)
post.description: Mock operations and responses become stubs matched on SOAPAction (SOAP 1.1) or the content-type action (SOAP 1.2) and the body root element. Dispatch styles: SEQUENCE and RANDOM become response lists, XPATH and QUERY_MATCH become XPath body matchers; SCRIPT is never executed (warning, default response).

post.summary: Turn journal entries into stubs (WireMock snapshot)
post.description: Selects journal entries (newest 10000 passing `source`, `since`, `matched`; then `ids` and `request`), oldest first, and converts each distinct request into a stub with the recorded status and body. The journal keeps redacted, size-limited bodies, so secrets never reach the generated stubs; truncated bodies are reported as warnings.

post.summary: Create a managed token
post.description: Returns the token value once. The caller needs `tokens:write` and every permission of the role in each requested scope (globally for `global: true`), so a token never holds more than its creator; a caller bound only to spaces cannot create global tokens. Expiry is mandatory.

400.description: Invalid name, role, scope or lifetime

403.description: The caller cannot grant this role in these scopes

409.description: An active token or a static token has this name

ignoreExtraArrayItems.description:
equalToJson: an actual array may hold more items than the expected one (WireMock
`ignoreExtraElements`, MockServer `ONLY_MATCHING_FIELDS`).

oneOf.description:
JSONPath dialect: `rfc9535` (default) or `jayway` (WireMock: `=~`, `in`, `nin`, `length()`,
filters applied to objects).

A body matcher applied to each node selected by jsonPath or xpath; objects and arrays are matched as
their JSON text (WireMock `matchesJsonPath` with `equalToJson`, `matchesJsonSchema`, `equalToXml`).

space.description: Space of the stub that scheduled the callback.

detailsHidden.description:
True when request/response excerpts, message excerpts and error texts were removed because
the caller is a viewer.

space.description: Space the run was started in; absent in the global area.

name.description: `[A-Za-z0-9._@-]`, at most 128 characters; unique among active tokens and distinct from the static token names.

role.description: Built-in role (`viewer`, `editor`, `admin`) or a custom role of the access file.

spaces.description: Spaces the role is granted in. Set either `spaces` or `global: true`.

expiresInDays.description: Lifetime in days: 1 to `FASTMOCK_TOKENS_MAX_DAYS` (default 365); 90 when omitted.

description.example: CI pipeline of the billing team

token.description: The token value (`fm_` and 64 hex digits). Returned only in this response: store it now.

required.description: On 403: the built-in role (for principals holding only global built-in roles) or the permission the request needs.

space.description: Space of the file; absent in the global area. `name` is relative to the space.

total.description: All matching entries in the scanned window (may exceed `requests.len()`).

schema.description: GraphQL SDL. A `# microcksId: <name> : <version>` comment names the service.

examples.description: Optional Microcks APIExamples (YAML/JSON text or object) with examples per query or mutation.

tag.description: Tag for the generated stubs (default: the service id).

har.description: HAR 1.2 document as a JSON object or JSON text.

mimeTypes.description: Keep only entries whose response MIME type starts with one of these, e.g. `application/json`.

hosts.description: Keep only entries for these hosts.

captureHeaders.description: Response headers to keep besides content-type (sensitive ones are always dropped).

HeaderValues.description: One header value, or an array of values sent as separate header lines (for example `Set-Cookie`).

topicNaming.description:
Kafka topic names: `channel` (default, the channel address) or `microcks`
(`<service>-<version>-<channel>`, as Microcks publishes).

imported.description: Stubs saved (0 on a dry run).

removed.description: Stubs deleted because they carried the replaced tag.

stubs.description: The generated stubs, only on a dry run.

space.description: Space of the stub that matched; absent for unmatched requests and global stubs.

score.description: Share of the pattern's matchers that matched, 0..1.

document.description: An APIExamples or APIMetadata document (YAML/JSON text or object).

expectations.description: One expectation or an array of expectations.

MockServerImportBody.description: One expectation, an array of expectations, or the wrapper with `expectations`.

spec.description: OpenAPI 3 document as a JSON object or as JSON/YAML text.

spaces.description: Permissions granted only in single spaces, by space; the effective permissions in a space are these plus the global ones.

collection.description: Postman Collection v2.1 (or v2.0) as a JSON object or JSON text.

role.description: The highest built-in role whose permissions the principal holds everywhere (`viewer` when it holds less); kept for older clients, decide with `permissions`.

captureHeaders.description: Response headers to keep in recorded stubs (content-type is always kept).

requestHeaders.description: Request headers to add as matchers.

headers.description: Header values: a string, or an array of strings sent as separate header lines.

space.description: Space of the scenario; absent in the global area.

matched.description: Number of patterns found in order.

requestIds.description: Journal ids of the requests that satisfied the patterns, in order.

captureHeaders.description: Request headers to add as `equalTo` matchers (sensitive ones become `matches: .+`).

repeatsAsScenarios.description: Turn repeated identical requests with different responses into a scenario.

persist.description: Save the stubs (default true); false only returns them.

tag.description: Tag added to every generated stub, next to `recorded`.

oneOf.description: Only entries matching this request pattern.

document.description: The SoapUI project XML (`/import/soapui`) or the WSDL 1.1 document (`/import/wsdl`).

tag.description: Tag for the generated stubs (default: the service id).

path.description: Endpoint path; default: the mock service path (SoapUI) or the port address path (WSDL).

mockService.description: SoapUI only: which mock service to import when the project has several.

pathPrefixes.description: Data-plane path prefixes the space's stubs must stay under (empty: no restriction).

hosts.description: Hosts the space's stubs must match (empty: no restriction).

permissions.description: The caller's effective permissions in the space.

allValues.description:
Every value of a multi-valued parameter must match at least one of these matchers, and at least one
value must be present (MockServer `keyMatchStyle: MATCHING_KEY`).

order.description:
Tie-breaker between stubs of equal priority: the lower value is tried first. A stub with an `order`
is placed before stubs without one, and URL specificity is not used for it. Set by the WireMock
(newest wins) and MockServer (oldest wins) importers.

space.description:
Space the stub belongs to (see access control); absent for the global area. Set on create and never
changed afterwards.

TokenInfo.description: Metadata of a managed token; the value is never shown again after creation.

spaces.description: Spaces of the token; empty for a global token.

createdBy.description: Name of the principal that created the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Last use, recorded at most once per minute.

TopicNaming.description:
How Kafka topics are named: after the channel (default) or as Microcks does,
`<service name without spaces and dashes>-<version>-<channel with / replaced by ->`.

bearer.description: Static admin token from FASTMOCK_ADMIN_TOKENS or a managed token from POST /__admin/tokens. Every route needs a permission (`resource:action`); the built-in roles viewer, editor and admin are permission sets, custom roles and space bindings come from FASTMOCK_ACCESS_FILE. Without an access file: GET/HEAD and read-only POSTs need viewer, other changes editor; deleting all stubs, reset and the audit log need admin.
